scripts.copy-migrations: mkdir -p dist/migrations && cp src/migrations/*.sql dist/migrations/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readdirSync('src/migrations').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.sql'));const b=fs.readdirSync('dist/migrations');const missing=a.filter(f=>!b.includes(f));if(missing.length){console.error('Migrations missing from dist:',missing);process.exit(1)}console.log('migrations: '+a.length+' copied to dist')"
